title: Shorshe Ilish
description: Shorshe Ilish is a Bangladesh dish made with mackerel, serrano pepper, cilantro. This home-scale recipe assigns measured ingredients to the steps where they are used. Mackerel replaces hilsa (ilish); mustard oil and mustard seasoning retain the intended sauce style.

steps.instruction: Combine the seasoning ingredients and coat the main protein or vegetables. Rest covered in the refrigerator for about 20 minutes.
Combine the listed ingredients in a bowl until evenly mixed; avoid overworking delicate components.
Arrange mustard-marinated mackerel in a heatproof dish and steam until the fish flakes easily and is thoroughly cooked; use food-grade mustard oil.
Finish with the listed ingredients, check seasoning and serve immediately.
